column3: A Worker can clone and read git itself with a hand-written pack reader: one smart-HTTP v2 fetch, a git v2 .idx built with workerd's native zlib, pack + idx in R2 (3 writes)
column4: the question was whether git runs on the Worker at all; isomorphic-git runs but costs 27.5 s for a 10 MB repo in the Worker, while the same clone with node:zlib and a 400-line reader is 3.5 s
column5: test/git-native/ on branch git/native-worker; express full (9.7 MB, 32,576 objects) 3,532 ms in wrangler dev, log 1 ms, diff 3 ms; isomorphic-git 27,465 ms; docs/reports/2026-11-10-native-git-in-worker.md
column6: prototype only, not shipped: 16-git.md still says no clone; a real row needs incremental fetch, R2 range reads and a pack-size policy
